facts.fact: We Are Tech Africa reports the e-Tax platform, with online tax filing (télédéclaration) and online payment (télépaiement), already has 301 large and 325 medium firms registered on it.
The Central African Republic adopted e-Tax, backed by the European Union, and an information and training workshop for DGID agents and taxpayers opened in Bangui on 27 January 2025.

systems.owner: Direction générale des impôts et des domaines (DGID)
